tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /snyan brgyud yab bka' bde mchog lus dkyil du dbang bskur ba'i zin bris 'jug bde'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /snyan brgyud yab bka' bde mchog lus dkyil du dbang bskur ba'i zin bris 'jug bde'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// snyan brgyud yab bka' bde mchog lus dkyil du dbang bskur ba'i zin bris 'jug bde'i lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha'i rdo rje bde chen 'gyur med sku// srid zhi'i dngos kun stong chen 'khor lo ru// sdom mdzad bla ma he ru kar btud nas// lus dkyil smin byed lag len 'dir dbye'o/ 'dir dpal he ru ka lus kyi dkyil 'khor du sgrub par bya ba'i 'jug sgo smin byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul cung zad gsal bar bya ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi rim pa/ dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i gnas nye bar brgyan la/ dam tshig gi bris sku sogs bkram pa'i mdun du bde mchog gtso bo lnga pa'i bdag nyid can gyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ram/ yang na gtso bo lnga'i 'bru tshom bkod pa bshams pas kyang 'thus par gsungs/ de'i mdun du rnam bum/ dung chos gzungs rdor ldan pa dang*/ shar sgo'i g.yon du las bum/ lhor dbu rgyan/ nub tu rdo rje/ byang du dril bu/ lhor bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i gsang dbang gi thod chang*/ nub tu rig tsaka dang*/ gzhan yang me long mig thur sogs dbang gi rdzas rnams gang bder bshams/ 'jig rten 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad phyi gtor sogs dgos pa'i yo byad tshogs par byas la/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ cang te'u/ bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i nang mchod sogs 'du bya/ stan bde bar 'khod la/ dngos gzhi bdag mdun phyi gtor/ bum bskyed/ bdag 'jug tshogs mchod bcas sgrub mchod ltar legs par grub nas/ gsol ba gdab cing gnang ba nod pa ni/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal ba rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin kho na nyid las skyes// bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog

/ ces brjod/ de nas dbang bskur ba la sngon du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ phyis nas dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad pa'i phyi rol du gzhug par 'os pa'i slob ma rnams bos la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas khrus bya/ nang du 'ongs nas phyag btsal zhing gus pas 'khod pa la maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu bya/ bgegs kyi gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ gtor ma oṃ gyis sbyangs/ āḥs yid dang mthun par mang por spel/ hūm̐ gis kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlabs/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// lus srul la sogs gang ci yang*// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du dengs// ci ste ngas bsgo su zhig 'da'// rdo rje bdag po sku yis ni// lus srul las skyes 'gas byas te// 'dir ni brlag 'gyur gzhan du min// sa yi phyogs 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis dpal he ru ka mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal por 'jug cing dbang zhu bar byed pa la bar du gcod par brtsam pa gang su yang rung ba sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang klu dang lha ma yin dang gnod sbyin dang srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ rjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa rgan po dang rgan mo dang g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig 'di ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag phyag na rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba hūm̐ ka ra shin tu khros pa ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun nas rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ ces brjod/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol bzhin zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bskrad/

yungs thun 'thor zhing*/ gu gul bdug gtor ma phyir dor ro// de nas thugs ka nas spros pa'i hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ me dī ni sogs/ ces bsrung ba'i 'khor los bcing*/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces gsung bar bya ste/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i mar gyur sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa kha sbyor yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po shrī he ru ka'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du dpal he ru ka lus kyi dkyil 'khor du sgrub pa'i thabs zab mo'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug nas lam gyi rim pa thams cad mngon du bgyi'o snyam pas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa legs par gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de la gang zhig gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi dka' 'grel pad+ma can zhes bya ba slob dpon rat+na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mos pa dman pa rnams kyi phyir nyan thos kyi theg pa nye bar bstan la/ zab mo la mos pa rnams kyi phyir dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi phyir pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul rab tu gsal bar mdzad nas/ mchog tu zab pa'i snod rnams kyi phyir dpal 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten du nag pa zla ba'i nya la/ dpal chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te sngags kyi tshul gyi bstan bcos mtha' dag gsal bar mdzad do/ zhes gsungs pa nyid/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang po dang bar pa dang tha mar bzhag la/ de ltar bshad tshul 'di 'thad ldan yin pa'i sgrub byed kyang rtsa rgyud le'u tha mar/ bya ba spyod pa mdo sde dang*/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba nyid/ sems can mos pas 'jug pa rnams/ de dang de la dga' ba sbyin/ zhes gsungs la lung 'di'i don ches gsal ba sdom pa 'byung bar/ 'dul ba'i gnas la sogs pa kun/ nyan thos bdag nyid bstan pa'o/

sna tshogs mdo sde'i rnam bshad che/ byang chub sems dpa'i bstan pa'o/ rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud/ gsang ba sangs rgyas spyod yul te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar las phyi ma/ de las kyang rnal 'byor bla med/ de las kyang phyi ma'i rgyud/ de'i nang nas kyang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa rtsa ba'i rgyud gzhir bzhag nas 'chad par bya/ rtsa ba'i rgyud de la yang re shig gsum du bzhag pa'i rgyas pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku/ 'bring po ni 'og min chen por ston pa rdo rje 'chang gis rgyun mi 'chad par gsung pa de yin te/ rgyud las/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bye ba dang*/ dpa' bo bye bas legs par gsungs/ zhes bshad pa dang*/ bsdus pa la'ang gsum ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyud ni rgyud chen po/ zhes pas rgyas pa dang*/ bsdus pa rnams pa'i gzugs can te/ zhes pas bsdus pa dang*/ yi ge kun gyi za ma tog /ces pas shin tu bsdus pa bstan/ shin tu bsdus pa de la yang gsum gyi dang po sho lo ka 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa drug le'u 'bum pa ste rigs pa rgya mtsho/ bsdus pa mngon brjod 'bum pa ste nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ shin tu bsdus pa shwo lo ka bdun brgya pa bde mchog nyung ngu 'di ste 'di gang las bsdus zhe na mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ de ltar nges brjod gsum 'bum las/ phyung ba bde chen nyung ngu ste/ a yig la sogs k+ṣa yig mthar/ le'u rnams ji lta'i rim pa yi/ de kho na nyid ldan par sbyar/ zhes rtsa rgyud rgyas pa de las byung*/ de yang yi ge ā li kā li lnga bcu'i bdag nyid kyi le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod par bshad la/ phyag rdor bstod 'grel du/ de nas mngon brjod 'bum pa yi/ rgyud las snying po phyung ba ni/ ces rtsa rgyud 'bum pa las phyung bar bshad pa gnyis dgongs pa cung mi mthun pa ltar snang yang don la mi 'gal te/ kun spyod las/ nges par brjod pa 'bum sde las/ sdom pa btus par gyur pa dang*/

nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa'i rgyud/ 'bum gcig nang du de nyid bshad/ ces gsungs te/ de ni bsdus gzhi rgyas pa dang 'bring po'i nang du'ang yod pas de nas kyang phyung bar song ba la dgongs/ rnam pa gzhan du na/ rig pa rgya mtsho la dpa' bo'i/ mdor bsdus nas ni gsungs pa yin/ zhes pa dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa su zhig gis spong bar nus/ gnyis pa bshad rgyud ngos bzung ba la/ slob dpon mi thub zla bas/ mkha' 'gro 'byung ba kun spyod dang*/ de bzhin mtshan mchog bla ma'i rgyud/ kha sbyor rgyud dang bzhi po ni/ bshad pa'i rgyud du shes par bya/ zhes dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ mkha' 'gro dang ni sdom rgyud dang*/ nges par brjod pa phyi ma dang*/ kun spyod 'byung ba'i rgyud rnams su/ zhes bshad pa'i mkha' 'gro ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ sdom rgyud dang*/ kha sbyor ram sam+bu ṭi/ 'byung ba kun spyod dang*/ kun spyod 'byung ba 'gyur khyad de don gcig de bzhin du nges brjod bla ma dang*/ nges brjod phyi ma dang*/ mngon brjod bla ma'ang 'gyur khyad de don gcig /jo bo rjes/ nges brjod mngon 'byung mkha' 'gro mas/ snying po bsdus pa bdag gis bshad/ zhes te/ mi thub zla bas bgrangs pa bzhi'i khar/ he ru ka mngon 'byung bsnan pa lnga/ sdom pa 'byung ba/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ phag mo dngos grub 'byung ba/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor/ mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud dang bcu/ ra li so gnyis mkhas pa kha gcig rtsod pa can du bzhed/ la las yang dag tu bzhed/ phag mo mngon 'byung mi gcig pa tshan pa gnyis kyang rgyud rdzun mar bod ston chen po 'ga' gsungs bar snang yang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ zab mo'i chos ni ston pa la/ gal te mos par ma gyur kyang*/ smod pa dag ni mi bya ste/ chos nyid bsam mi khyab dran bya/ zhes pa'i lung drangs nas mos pa'i yul du rang lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed pa yin/ rtsa ba'i rgyud gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyud de dag gsungs pa'i dus la slob dpon rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel par gnyis ldan gyi dus su drag po dbang phyug chen po brtul ba'i dus su gsungs par bzhed/

bod kyi bla ma phal gyi bzhed pa ltar na/ rtsod ldan kyi dus su gsungs zhes 'chad mod kyang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad+ma dkar po'i bzhed pa la/ 'dzam bu'i gling yon tan rgyal mtshan can 'di chags nas ring por ma lon pa dang*/ zhes dang*/ rdzogs ldan gyi dus su gsungs pa'i rgyud ces yang yang bka' stsal bas na 'dir ni de bzhin du 'dod/ gdul bya'i dbang du byas na drag po 'jigs byed khyo shugs kyis yul nyer bzhi dang dur khrod brgyad bdag gir bzung ba'i lha dang dri za dang*/ gnod sbyin dang srin po dang*/ klu dang lha ma yin dang*/ mi'am ci dang phra man pa dang bcas pa'i sum cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa 'dul ba'i don du gsungs/ ji ltar gsungs na/ bshad rgyud mngon brjod bla ma las/ de nas dgongs pa sna tshogs pa'i dam tshig chen po'i rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sems can gyi chos kyi dbyings kun tu gang bar gzigs nas rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas 'khor gyi tshogs sna tshogs pa spros te sna tshogs pa 'dul ba'i thabs kyis nam mkha'i khams yongs su gang bar snang bar gyur to/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bdag po sna tshogs pa'i sku 'dzin pa/ sems can la phan par rjes su dgongs la/ thugs rje chen po dang khro bo'i nyams gnyis su med par sbyor bas ngo mtshar sna tshogs shing mtha' yas pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs rdul phra rabs dang mnyam pa'i khams gsum gyi bdag po nyid du yang dag par bstan nas/ chu dang me dang rlung dang dbang chen gyi snyeng du sna tshogs pa'i ri'i rgyal po ri rab rin po che sna tshogs pa'i gzi brjid kyis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings las spros pa'i rdo rje khro bo chen po las byung ba'i rdo rje chen po'i gzhal yas khang dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po sprul pa la kun tu bzang po las byung ba'i rdo rje chen po'i 'khor rnams 'dus shing 'khor par gyur to/

zhes gsungs la/ de lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyis 'jigs byed khyo shugs/ thugs 'khor bas mkha' spyod/ gsung 'khor bas sa spyod/ sku 'khor bas sa 'og spyod/ sgo mtshams mas dur khrod na gnas pa brgyad dbang byed pa dang*/ longs spyod pa dang*/ thim pa'i tshul gyis brtul te/ mnyam sbyor las/ sdig med stobs kyi ngo 'thob tu/ dbang phyug dam pa rab mnan nas/ lha mo bhi mo phrog nas ni/ de tshe longs spyod rang gir spyod/ zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe rtsa ba'i rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug le'u 'bum pa gsungs/ gdul bya de dag kyang 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma'i bdag nyid du gyur pas dam pa'i chos thams cad 'dzin nus pa sha stag yin pas nyams pa med mod kyang*/ mi'i 'gro ba dag gi spyod yul du ma gyur pas/ shākya thub pas dpal 'bras spungs su sham+bha la'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis gtsos pa'i mi rnams la rgyud kyi rgyal po legs par bstan pa de rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bsdus pa yin te/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ ma mo thams cad 'dus rnams kyi/ rdo rje'i gnas rnams su bsdus so/ zhes gsungs so/ de las grub thob rnams kyi spyod yul du gyur pa mang zhig yod mod kyang*/ 'dir ni de thams cad las phul du byung ba yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i lugs yin pas na mkha' 'gro snyan rgyud ces grags/ de las phyi sgro 'dogs gcod par byed pa sprul pa sku'i gdams ngag brgyud pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ nang nyams len longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i gdams ngag smin lam yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ gsang ba ngo sprod chos sku'i gdams ngag grol lam yid bzhin gyi nor bu ste skor gsum las 'dir smin lam/ de la yab bka' gsum dang yum bka' gsum/ bka' srung gi mtha' brten dang bcas pa las skabs su babs pa 'dir ni yab bka' bsdus pa ste/

lus kyi dkyil 'khor du drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bkod nas lus kyi chos de dang de yi rang bzhin du 'brel zhing*/ sbyong byed du 'gyur ba can yin la/ sbyang gzhi khams dang dbang po/ sbyang byed rtsa khams phra ba'i lus dkyil/ sbyang 'bras sku dang zhing khams te/ rtsa khams de dag dul bas rlung 'dus pa la brten phyi'i yul chen dbang du 'du zhing*/ pho nya mo rnams kyi 'du ba khyad par can myur du thob pa sogs dgos pa khyad par can gyi chos mang po dang bcas pa ste/ kun mkhyen chen pos sgrub thabs dang dbang gi cho ga zung 'brel du bzhugs pa ltar gyi khyad par can dang 'brel ba'i smin byed kyi rim pa sgrub par byed pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ til+li pa/ nā ro dzñā na sid+dhi/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/ mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rgyal ba khyung tshang pa/ ma gcig kong jo/ zhang lo grub pa dpal/ dha ra shrī/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kun ldan ras ma/ bde legs rin chen/ gangs can kun dga' dpal/ rgyal dbang chos rje/ ngag dbang chos rgyal/ kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po/ ngag dbang bzang po/ dpag bsam dbang po/ kun dga' lhun grub/ mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug rje dge legs bzhad pa/ 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i dbang phyug dang*/ mi pham yar 'phel dbang po/ phyi ma las ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ lhan skyes bde chen rdo rje/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo/ chos kyi snang ba/ rje ye shes grub pa/ 'jigs med mi 'gyur/ bshad sgrub chos kyi nyin byed/ mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma/ rigs brgya'i spyi gzugs he ru ka mthu stobs chos kyi rgya mtsho dge legs rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i bka' drin las legs par thob pa yin la/ brgyud pa khyad par can de las 'ongs ba'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba zab mo 'bul ba la/ bdag nyid kyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams sngon du song grub nas/
da rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal re 'bul bar zhu/

maṇ+ḍal phul grub nas/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sngon du song nas bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ mdun du dul bar 'dug pa dang*// gos sogs tshul ni bsdams pa dang*/ pus btsug thal mo sbyar ba yis// nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum gdab// ces pa ltar snyan gsan dbab pa'i gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// lan gsum/ de nas bla ma dpal he ru ka'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la/ dad mos rtse gcig pas phyag thal mo sbyar te dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir/ khyad par gyi gsol ba gdab pa 'di rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ sogs lan gsum/ de nas rtsa rgyud las/ bu sdug de dag gdong pa la// dar ras legs par bkab nas su// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon chad dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'di nyid ma mthong ba mtshon byed du gdong dar yug dmar po res 'ching bar mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar 'ching*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten du me tog gi chun po re phyag tu thogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a khaṃ bi ra hūm̐/ yang sdom 'byung las/ kye khyod su zhes dri bya ste/ bdag ni skal bzang zhes kyang smra/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dris pa'i lan du bdag ni skal bzang ngo zhes lan gdab dgos pas de ltar mdzod// kye khyod su zhig ces dris la/ bdag ni skal bzang ngo*/ zhes lan gdab/ de nas rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzobs byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa res mtshan par mos la/ sngags 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ lan gsum/ de nas nged kyis snying gar rdo rje reg pas byang chub kyi sems de nam yang mi nyams par brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

su ra ste sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes snying gar rdo rjes reg rtsa rgyud las/ de nas bskor ba byas nas ni// blo bzang yid ni mnyam bzhag pas// pho brang nyams dgar 'jug par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ a khaṃ bi ra hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor gyi nang du chud par mos shig yol ba bsal/ phyi dkyil gyi lho sgo nas g.yon skor gyis shar khyams su zhugs te lha rnams la dmigs pas phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ sngags 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ na ma te hūm̐/ na ma mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyis thugs kar bkug ste pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyi'i shar khyams su bzhag pa skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang de'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzugs su gyur par mos mdzod/ de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i nang du 'jug pa la/ sngon du sdom pa bsgrags cing bzung dgos pas de'i ched du gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur mchog /sogs lan gsum/ de nas nged kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab ste gnang ba zhu ba ste/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams ni/ byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin zhing*// gsang ba'i don gyi 'khor lo 'dir// dam tshig sdom la 'jug par 'tshal// lan gcig de nas spro ba 'dri ba 'di la gsan 'tshal/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i// gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni// bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam// zhes dris pa'i lan gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag ni rab tu de 'tshal lo// de ltar sdom pa bzung 'dod par khas blangs nas/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo nas byung ba'i sdom pa bsgrag pa 'di la gsan 'tshal/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ sogs/ zhes bshad do// de yang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba rnam snang gi dam tshig

/rdo rje dril bu dang phyag rgya slob dpon bzung ba bzhi rdo rje rigs kyi/ chos zang zing mi 'jigs pa byams pa sbyin pa bzhi rin chen rigs kyi/ phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum 'dzin pa gsum pad+ma rigs kyi/ 'dir phyi ni rgyud sde phyi ma/ gsang ba rnal 'byor/ de yang rnal 'byor chen po dang*/ rnal 'byor bla ma/ rnal 'byor bla med gsum la bya ba yin/ sdom pa 'dzin pa dang mchod pa gnyis las rigs kyi dam tshig /'dir 'dzin rgyu'i sdom pa so thar dang kun rdzob byang sems gnyis dran pas dbang po sdom pa dang*/ shes bzhin gyis yid sdom par byed dgos pa ni de gnyis kyi zhar las byung*/ de ltar mthun phyogs la bcu bzhi 'byung ba/ de las gzhan pa bcu bzhi ni/ phas pham par rab tu bshad do/ ji tsam gyis spangs zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ byas na rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes brjod do/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i de nyid bsdus pa dum bu dang po'i 'grel chen las/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa phas pham bcu bzhi las ldog pa'i mtshan nyid can no/ zhes dang*/ dpal mchog dum bu gnyis pa'i 'grel par/ phyag rgya la sogs pa 'di dag gis ci zhig bya/ zhes bya bas 'di yongs su spangs na pham par 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs/ dam tshig de dag kyang bsgrags pa tsam gyis mi chog khas blangs pa zhig dgos pas de'i slad du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson/ sogs nas/ 'das la 'god/ lan gsum/ des thun mong gi sdom pa blangs ba'i rim pa song nas 'dir sngags kyi sdom pa lus ngag yid thabs shes zab mo'i rang bzhin du sdom pa'i tshul khrims de thob pa yin nam zhe na/ de la 'jug pas bsdus pa tsam zhig thob kyi gzhan ni ma yin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni/ e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas/

dbang las yang dag shes par 'gyur/ zhes rang lugs dbang thob pa dang sngags sdom thob pa don gcig par lung de lta bu sogs pas bstan par 'dod do/ rigs gang gi dbang thob pa na/ de dang de'i rigs can du grub pa yin la/ de nas rigs dang mthun pa'i las bya dgos pa yin gyi/ gzhan du gdol pa la rgyal rigs kyi bya ba mi rigs pa bzhin no/ de bas na thun mongs ma yin pa'i sdom pa blangs ba 'di'i rjes zlos/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs/ legs par gsungs/ lan gsum/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i sngon du 'gro ba dam la bzhag par bya ba ste/ rgyud las/ ye shes dbab pa de gsang na dngos grub tu 'gyur la/ ma gsang na dam 'gal gyi chad pas sreg par 'gyur bas khas nyen che bas gal la gcun nas mna' dor ba'i rdo rje chu sbyin pa ste/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// sogs/ a mṛ tot+ta ka hūm̐/ zhes mna' chu blud/ de nas gsang ba'i 'jug pa dngos ni/ byin dbab pa yin la/ byin ni rdo rje byin pa/ de slob ma la brlams su 'jug pa ni dbab pa yin la/ de yang gsang sngags byin rlabs kyi lam/ byin rlabs mos gus kyi lam yin pas/ byin gyis rlobs dang mi rlobs mos gus la rag las pas/ bla ma dang yi dam la rtse gcig pa'i mos gus dang bcas pas ye shes dbab pa'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum gyi ye shes chen po'i byin dbab par bya ba la/ khyed rang rnams sgo gsum gyi gnad gcun te dngos po dang mtshan pa gang la'ang ma chags par mos gus gdung ba'i shugs drag tu bskyed pa'i bla ma dang gtso bo gnyis su med pa'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du zhugs pas lus mer gyis zhu bar bsam/ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya hūm̐/

oṃ shrī he ru ka bid+yā ma hā bid+yā rā dza dhīḥm he swā hā/ zhes dpa' bo bskul ba'i sngags bgrangs/ bdud rtsi lnga/ rdul gyis sbags pa'i bu mo'i 'dom dkris/ byi la'i brun/ gu gul gses pa/ thod par bcug pa yi dwags kyi me la bsregs te bdug /rol mo'i sgra drag por bsgrags pas slob dpon nus pa che na de la dpal he ru ka dngos su phebs par 'gyur la/ gzhan du cha shas tsam mo// phebs pa na/ de ltar dbab pa'i ye shes pa de nyid byang chub ma thob bar du rgyud la brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje'i rgya gram bzhag ste brtan par bya/ de nas rigs brtags pa'i phyir me tog 'dor ba la/ rtsa rgyud las/ lho yi phyogs su lus bstan la// thal mo me tog de nas dor// zhes gsungs pa ltar bum mtshan gyi tshom bu 'di nyid lha yi 'khor lor shes par byos la bdag gi rigs gang yin pa'i lha de la phog par gyur cig snyam pas pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod cing me tog gi phreng ba ltos med du dor mdzod/ ces 'dor du gzhug /de ltar dor ba'i me tog de nyid lha de'i mtshan ma dang*/ de dang nye bar babs na de yi rigs su shes par gyis shig ces gang la phog pa lhag par lhar brda sprad/ dngos grub kyi tshul lam lha des rjes su 'dzin par dgongs pas phreng ba slob ma'i spyi bor bcing bar mos shig pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ mi maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir mig dar dkrol ba ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ sogs/ pa tra laṃ hrīḥ mig dar dkrol/ de nas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya ba ste/ rtsa rgyud las/ slob ma bzang po gdong phye la// de nas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya// zhes pas dkyil 'khor la gdong phyogs pas gzigs mdzod/ rdo rje'am phyag shing sogs kyis mtshon te/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// sogs/

ces brjod pas dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum gsal bar mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar dkyil 'khor mthong ba la yang mtshon byed dpe yi dkyil 'khor bris sgom byas pa/ mtshon bya don gsang ba'i 'jug pa las rtogs pa mar pas mi la la/ mtshon bya don gyi dkyil 'khor 'di na zhes brtan pas des drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum gzigs pa lta bu'o/ gang gis mthong yang*/ skye ba sngon bsags sdig pa rnams/ dkyil 'khor mthong bas byang bar 'gyur/ zhes te/ rtsa rgyud las/ mthong ba dang ni zhugs pa las/ sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur ba/ de lta nyid du the tshom med/ ces sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgya cher gsungs pas so// de dag 'jug pa'i rim pa yin la/ da zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la/ gzhi yi dus la lus ngag yid ye shes bzhi la/ lam gyi dus su sbyong byed dbang bzhi bskur bas/ 'bras bu'i dus su thob bya sku bzhir 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis te/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ dri ma bzhi dag nus pa bzhi smin la// yongs su smin par bzhag pa gang gis te// byas nus thabs la rgyal bas dbang bskur gsung*/ de phyir dbang bskur de med dngos grub med// ces gsungs shing*/ rtsa rgyud las/ dgod dang lta dang lag 'dzin gyis// 'khyud dang gnyis sprod la sogs pa// dbang bskur bar ni 'gyur ba yin// zhes pa ltar dbang bzhi rim pas bskur ba ste/ de la yang*/ gang la lhag mos pa zhes pas sgrub pa po tsam zhig la mos na slob ma'i dbang dang*/ slob dpon du 'os pa la bum pa'i dbang rdzogs par bskur bas te de dang de'i dbang bskur bya dgos pa las/ da lam bum dbang rdzogs par zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ phul zin nas/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ de yang bum pa'i dbang la/ sdom 'byung las/ chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming gi dbang bskur te// dbang lnga de bzhin gshegs bdag nyid// ces pas dbang de dag de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dag pa sbyar nas gsungs la/

de las dang po mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rnam rgyal bum pa dang slob ma las sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ dbang rdzas kyi bum pa dang slob ma mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje/ de las mi bskyod pa sogs nas bum pa/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu ming gi dbang dang bcas pa dkyus ltar gyis rnal 'byor rgyud man chad 'chad pa la dbang ba yin no bar/ de nas gsung bzlas pa sngags kyi lung sbyin pa la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po sogs/ thim pa'i mos pa dang bcas te sngags 'di dag gi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ka sogs yab yum gyi snying po/ nye snying*/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye sogs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wi ri sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs rtsa sngags rkang pa brgyad pa dang*/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ sogs phreng ba'i sngags dang bcas pa'i bzlas lung sbyin/ rdo rje me tog dang bcas spyi bor bkod de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// sogs/ rtag tu bcangs/ zhes sngags dbang bskur/ de nas mtha' rten la brtul zhugs lung bstan dbugs dbyung ba rnams te/ de las brtul zhugs kyi dbang la/ rdo rje/ spyod pa/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs dang gsum las/ dang po rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa'/ de bzhu ba'i rdo rje lag tu gtad par mos mdzod/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ sogs/ brtul zhugs bstan/ de nas khyed rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba byin pas/ de rnams rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur ba yin pas de ltar nges par mdzod la rdo rje gsor te snying gar 'dzin nas sngags 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ ha ha hi spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni rig pa brtul zhugs kyi phyir te kha ṭ+wāṃ/

thod pa/ cang te'u/ phyag rgya drug rnams brgyan te/ sna tshogs bsam pa'i bye brag gis// sogs brtul zhugs sbyin/ spyod pa'i brtul gzhug go/ de nas rig ma'i brtul zhugs ni/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi phyir yin te/ shes rab kyi lag pa nas bzung ste gtad par mos mdzod/ 'di ni rang nyid mdzes pa ste/ sogs rig ma'i brtul gzhug go// de nas lung ston pa ni/ slob dpon shākya thub par gsal ba'i lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi rna ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar byas te bzung*/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas lung bstan pa stsal byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ sogs/ bhur bhu waḥswaḥ kye dpal shrī he ru ka dpal rdo rje zhes mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma kun gyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par mdzad de dad par bya'o// de nas dbugs dbyung bar bya ba ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid che// sogs/ zhugs pa yin// zhes dbugs dbyung*/ de rnams kyis phyi mtshan ma'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa dang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// de nas phyir mi ldog pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/

phul zin nas/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur gyis/ sogs lan gsum/ de yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sdom 'byung las/ gdugs dang gdan dang rigs pa sogs// rdo rje dril sogs yang dag ldan/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i slob dpon dbang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' phyir mi ldog /sbyin bya bum pa yang dag ldan// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ slob ma rnams seṅges btegs pa'i khri la 'khod cing*/ gdugs phub pa'i 'og tu gnas pa/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sogs gtso bo yab yum gyi skur bsgom la gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ go bskon pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan par gsal thob cig snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan drangs sogs nas bya ba mdzad bzhin du dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje chen po'i sogs/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa spyi bor bkod de dbang bskur/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis sogs/ badz+ra swā hā/ bar dang*/ de la sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas mchod par mos mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod par bya'o/ /de nas de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas// sogs/ mnyam med byos// de ni phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang ste ye shes kyi phung po rdo rje sems dpa'/ ro chen po'i khams chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug rnam par shes pa'i chos thams cad stong nyid ye shes rdo rjer dag pa yin no// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ skyob pa med pa rnams kyi skyabs/ sogs lan gsum/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la sngar ma zhugs pa mtshon byed du mig dar 'ching bar mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcing*/ dbang 'di ni rtsa rgyud las/

de nas spyan ras gzigs bshad de// zhes sogs kyis rgyas par bstan pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtso bo dang gnyis su med pa'i bla ma yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pas sogs/ lce thog tu byin nas dbang bskur bar mos mdzod/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// sogs/ de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro// de ltar dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas thams cad zhu ba'i rdzas su rig pas/ a ho ma hā su khaḥ zhes btung bar byos shig bdud rtsi byin pa sngags brjod bzhin myang ngo*/ de ltar bskur bas dam tshig kyang 'di lta lte/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// myang bar gyis// zhes phog oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar dkrol mdzod/ ces mig dar dkrol/ de ltar rdo rje slob dpon lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag sogs/ skal pa can du byas pa'o// gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ skyob pa med pa rnams kyi skyabs// sogs lan gsum/ phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor sngar ma mthong ba mtshon pa'i phyir oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar 'ching bar mdzod/ ces mig dar 'ching*/ /rtsa rgyud las/ de nas slob ma phyi de nyid// las ni yang dag spyad par bya// ces pas bstan te/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa in+d+ra ni la dang mtshungs pa sogs phyag rgya rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de'i lag pa nas bla mas bzung ste gtad par mos mdzod/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che// sogs/ mchod pa gyis/ zhes rig ma'i tsakli sbyin/ de ltar gtad pa'i phyag rgya des slob ma la spro ba 'dri ba 'di ltar/ dpa' bo bu khyod/ sogs bu yis smros/ zhes dris pa la/ lan gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/

ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams// sogs/ pad+ma cis mi mchod/ de nas phyag rgya de'i rang gi bha ga rgyas pa sogs nas/ dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes mngon du byas par mos la/ mig dar dkrol mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar dbye/ des phyag rgya'i bha ga'i sogs/ skal pa can du byas pa'o// de ltar dbang bskur nas rjes su gdams pa 'di la gsan 'tshal/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis/ sogs/ kun gyis shig dbang gsum pa'o// de nas dbang bzhi pa tshig gi dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis// lan gsum/ sngar gsum pa'i dbang gi skabs su phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de nyid dper byas te don gyi lhan skyes ye shes chen po ngo sprod pa'i ched du/ tshig gi brda sprod pa'i dbang bskur ba ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// sogs/ brjod du med pa'o// de ltar tshig gi brda sprad pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes kyi dri ma dag sogs/ skal pa can du byas pa'o// sngar phan chad 'khor ba na 'khor/ da res 'khor ba'i mtshams bcad pas tshe 'di'am skye ba bcu drug tshun la 'tshang rgya nges pas so snyam pas dga' ba sgom pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ sogs/ sras su da gyur to// de nas dam tshig 'bog pa ni/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya// rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya// ma byin pa yang khyod kyis longs// gzhan gyi bud med bsten par gyis// de yang*/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'i lhar khyer bas dngos 'jin gyi srog bcad pa ste/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya/ zhes pa'i brjod bya bum dbang gi dam tshig gzhom med skad kyis smra ba rdzun tshig ste/ rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ zhes pa'i brjod bya gsang dbang gi dam tshig /phyag rgya'i dwangs ma dbang du sdud pa ma sbyin len te/

ma sbyin pa yang khyod kyis long*/ zhes pa'i brjod bya shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dam tshig /yas brtan pa'i bde ba 'gyur med chen po'i rgyas btab pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bud med bsten pa ste/ gzhan gyi bud med bsten par gyis/ zhes pa'i brjod bya tshig dbang gi dam tshig /de dag ni dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bzhi yin pas don de ltar du thugs la nges pa mdzod/ 'o de dag gi bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa legs par thob pa yin pas sku drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de nas yon 'bul ba ni/ gang gi bla ma mnyes byed pa/ sogs/ bran du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ snyam pas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ sogs/ /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// de nas dbang bskur ba las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo zhing shis pa brjod/ tshogs la rol/ gtor 'bul byas la/ lhag ma btang*/ gtang rag mchod bstod/ nongs bshags bzod gsol/ 'dod gsol sogs ci ltar rig pa byas rjes/ mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs bya/ snying ga'i 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad sogs bdag bskyed bsdu/ dge bsngo shis brjod bcas yongs su 'grub pa'o// dbang gi sta gon dang 'jug pa dkyil 'khor rgyas pas kha bskang na bcu gsum pa'i dbang bsdus par yang 'gyur ro// zhes pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o// gsungs pa bzhin dbang gi 'gros spyir bcu gsum ma dang mtshungs par bkod pa'o// bla med gsang mtha'i snyan rgyud nor bu'i mdzod/ gsum las smin lam yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal// skal bzang gdengs can gtsug gi rgyan dam par// sbyin pa'i thabs mchog kun mkhyen gsung gsang mdzod// rgyud ldan zhal lung cung zad gsal byas 'dir// ma rig nongs kun bla ma he ru ka'i// spyan sngar 'chags shing dge ba'i chab rgyun gyis// 'gro tshogs gzhi rgyud dri ma yongs dag nas// phung khams gdan gsum rdo rje'i grong khyer du// khyab bdag he ru kar 'grub rgyur cig

/de ltar snyan brgyud yab bka' bsdus pa lus dkyil kyi dbang gi cho ga kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung la 'jug bde'i lhan thabs 'di bzhin bri bar byos shig ces dpal mgon bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' stsal spyir phebs bzhin 'khrul zhig brgyad par 'bod pas yab bka' 'bring po'i cho ga dang sgo bstun nas bris pa ste ma rig dbang gyur nongs pa mtha' dag snying nas 'chags shing*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang mchis nges don snying po'i bstan pa rin po che yun du gsal ba'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
